title: ICP 7035 pigeon pea: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: ICP 7035 pigeon pea: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: ICP 7035 pigeon pea is a pigeon pea variety. About 142 days to harvest, 1.3 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: ICP 7035 is a registered pigeon pea variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2016 as NSIC 2016 PP 01. It takes about 142 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.28 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about ICP 7035 pigeon pea
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

ICP 7035 pigeon pea takes about 142 days from sowing to harvest. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot).

The pests and diseases that hit pigeon pea fields most often: [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 22.3 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 142 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.28 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of ICP 7035?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
